questions.stem: A light of wavelength 3 times the threshold wavelength (λ₀) is incident on a photosensitive material. If the wavelength of incident light is made one fourth and intensity is halved, the photoelectrons that are emitted will be:
explanation_steps: Given: first λ = 3λ₀ (longer than threshold, so no emission at first)
New λ = 3λ₀/4 = 0.75λ₀ which is below λ₀ so emission starts
Intensity halved would halve the number of electrons if the first beam had been able to emit
The intended school-level key is usually C (intensity halved ⇒ electrons halved), ignoring that 3λ₀ cannot emit
tips: Emission needs λ ≤ λ₀. Number of electrons follows intensity.

questions.stem: A balloon and its gondola have a total mass of 250 kg. When filled, the balloon contains 900 m³ of helium at a density of 0.18 kg/m³. Density of air = 1.25 kg/m³, g = 10 m/s². Find (a) the buoyant force on the balloon and (b) the extra load it can lift besides its own weight.
explanation_steps: Given: V = 900 m³, ρ_He = 0.18 kg/m³, m_shell = 250 kg, ρ_air = 1.25 kg/m³
Buoyant force = V ρ_air g = 900×1.25×10 = 11250 N
Total hanging mass = 250 + 162 = 412 kg, weight = 4120 N
marking_points: 1 for buoyant force 11250 N; 1 for extra load 713 kg or 7130 N
tips: Upthrust uses air density. Subtract weight of shell + helium.
